The remaining --py-* references are renderer-owned frame geometry and host layout variables such as device radius and side-panel width, not semantic design tokens.
--py-fixed-right-edge is a renderer-owned positioning measurement for floating chrome, not a semantic design token.

Device frames and simulated browser/window chrome need native controls to reproduce their shell affordances, such as minimize, rotate and home-indicator behavior.
Applies the simulated device's safe-area insets (from the renderer's frame) to its children; it is prototype device simulation, not a UI component Texuli could own.
Simulated desktop window chrome (traffic lights, title bar controls) reproduces an operating system's window affordances inside a device frame, like the renderer's frames.
The docs layout stays Protoyard's (ADR-044: texuli/layouts registers 11 of the 12 layouts); its deep-link ids and TOC rules also wait on gap G39.
